```{r Setup}
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: False

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```


```{r Import}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

M6_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_qv_06_test.sas7bdat")
```

# Corriger données d'identité

```{r M6_A0 to M6_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M6_A1 <- M6_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M6_A2 <- M6_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M6_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(qv_type:id_age_cat_3))
```

# Renommer et réordonner

```{r}
add_qv <- M6_A2 %>% 
  select(all_of(starts_with("sa_")),
         all_of(starts_with("sc_")),
         all_of(starts_with("am_")),
         ad_besoin,
         ad_lien,
         ad_type,
         ad_lien_autre) %>% 
  colnames()

M6_B0 <- M6_A2 %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0("qv_", .x), all_of(add_qv)) %>%
  rename("qv_commentaires" = "commentaires_qual",
         "qv_ad_act01" = "VAR11",
         "qv_ad_act02" = "VAR2",
         "qv_ad_act03" = "VAR3",
         "qv_ad_act04" = "VAR4",
         "qv_ad_act05" = "VAR5",
         "qv_ad_act06" = "VAR6",
         "qv_ad_act07" = "VAR7",
         "qv_ad_act08" = "VAR8",
         "qv_ad_act09" = "VAR9",
         "qv_ad_act10" = "VAR10",
         "qv_ad_act999" = "ad_activites_999",
         "qv_ad_act_autre" = "ad_activites_autre") %>% 
  
  # Mettre toutes les variables en ordre
  relocate(id_anonymat, id_doublon, id_keep, qv_date_creation,
           qv_sa_etat, qv_sa_mobilite, qv_sa_autonomie, qv_sa_activites,
           qv_sa_douleurs, qv_sa_anxiete, 
           qv_sa_compl, qv_sa_medic, qv_sa_antibio, qv_sa_kine, qv_sa_hospi, qv_sa_transp,
           qv_ad_besoin, qv_ad_act01, qv_ad_act02:qv_ad_act10, qv_ad_act999, qv_ad_act_autre,
           qv_ad_type, qv_ad_lien, qv_ad_lien_autre, 
           qv_sc_travailleur, qv_sc_difficultes, qv_sc_sport, qv_sc_spectacle, 
           qv_sc_vacances, qv_sc_contacts, qv_sc_heberger, qv_sc_aide_materielle,
           qv_am_regime, qv_am_regime_autre, qv_am_complement, 
           qv_am_type_1, qv_am_type_2, qv_am_type_999, qv_am_type_autre,
           qv_am_ald, qv_am_rac, qv_am_rac_montant, 
           qv_am_rac_pour_1:qv_am_rac_pour_autre, qv_commentaires, id_date_creation,
           id_centre1:id_sexe) %>% 
  
  # Retirer variable inutile
  select(-qv_sa_autre_precisez)
```

# Identifier absents

```{r}

vars_check <- M6_B0 %>%
  select(qv_sa_etat:qv_am_rac_pour_autre) %>%
  names()

M6_B1 <- M6_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    qv_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

```
